How do I use it properly the very first time?
Here’s a simple first-time setup:



Read the warmer instructions included in the box.


Set it on a safe, flat spot and plug it in.


If your warmer uses a bulb, remove any plastic around the bulb first.


Add wax: use 1–2 bears for Outlet/Mini Mod warmers.


Turn it on, or set the timer if your warmer has one.



Tip: If you have a silicone dish, you don’t need a liner.
If you have any other questions or need more tips, just let me know!
